patient._comment: 'patient' contains player-visible patient data and explanatory triage reasoning for Coach and review.

clinical.quoteLong: It started up by my belly button, then it packed up and MIGRATED down to the right like it had a GPS. Already threw up my ramen. Do NOT make me laugh, I'm serious, don't.
clinical.presentationShort: 19yo M — periumbilical pain migrated to RLQ over the day, N/V, guarding.
clinical.presentationLong: 19-year-old male, pain that started at the navel and migrated to the right lower quadrant over the day, with nausea, vomiting, and guarding.

triageReasoning.summary: This is a stable patient with a concerning abdominal presentation expected to require multiple diagnostic and treatment resources.
triageReasoning.acuityReason: Migrating right-lower-quadrant pain, vomiting, guarding, low-grade fever, and severe pain require an acute abdominal evaluation, but the patient has stable circulation, breathing, and oxygenation.
triageReasoning.destinationReason: ESI 3 / Acute is appropriate because the patient is stable but is expected to require a multi-resource evaluation and treatment.
keyFindings: Pain beginning near the umbilicus and migrating to the right lower quadrant
Guarding of the right lower abdomen
teachingPoints: A stable patient can still require an urgent multi-resource evaluation for a potentially surgical abdominal condition.
Expected resource use distinguishes this presentation from a lower-acuity abdominal complaint.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: The patient would likely remain without oral intake while receiving laboratory testing, abdominal imaging, symptom treatment, and surgical consultation if appendicitis is suspected.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting hunched, both hands guarding the lower-right belly
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a Black 19-year-old college guy in a hoodie, on the same blue clinic chair. Pose: sitting hunched, both hands guarding the lower-right belly. Expression: tense grimace, holding very still. Clearly visible: hands protecting the right-lower abdomen, slightly sweaty. Overall genuinely uncomfortable but stable. No text, no logos.
